tagline.zh: 把项目镜像变成实训课：本机与 SSH Docker 多节点资源池，按容量调度、排队与打散或集中编排，支持每人一台或小组共用及报告评分。平台闭源，按校授权私有化部署。
tagline.en: Turn project images into hands-on courses: a multi-node local/SSH Docker pool with capacity-aware scheduling, queues and spread/bin-pack placement, individual or shared group environments, and report grading. Closed source, licensed per school for private deployment.

tagline.zh: 东源县革命遗址导览平台：遗址图文详情、条件筛选、语音导览、导览路线与知识问答，配套管理后台维护内容。已交付为微信小程序。
tagline.en: A guide to the revolutionary heritage sites of Dongyuan County: illustrated entries, filters, audio guides, suggested routes and quizzes, with an admin console behind it. Delivered as a WeChat mini-program.
